0.original: Rawkin is in need of an adventurer with a strong pair of legs.

25.original: Deliver the earthenware vase to the Midlander merchant.

48.original: You've the look of a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who travels. Aye, a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> not afraid to do a bit of walking. Might be you could help me with something.

49.original: I was to make a delivery of provisions to Ala Ghiri, but it's taken me so long to get everything ready, I'm afraid I'll never get there by the agreed-upon time.

50.original: The only way I'd even have a chance at this point is to pass through the Scabbard.

51.original: That's assuming, of course, I don't break my legs climbing down the cliffside. By the look of you, I'm betting you could do it without breaking a sweat.

52.original: If you'd be willing to help, pick up that vase there and carry it down to Ala Ghiri.

53.original: The fastest way to Ala Ghiri is through the Scabbard. Mind your step climbing down the cliff.

54.original: Transport the earthenware vase to the specified location at Ala Ghiri before the Midlander merchant grows impatient and calls off the arrangement.

55.original: You will have two minutes to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.

56.original: Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength.

57.original: What in the hells is taking him so long? I haven't all day.

59.original: Rawkin's supplies! Thank you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, for coming all this way.

60.original: Tell him he can expect payment to be delivered in the next few days as promised.

61.original: I'm a man of my word. As soon as this shipment reaches its final destination, his payment will be sent at once.

62.original: You made it? Thank the gods.

63.original: Back in the day, I could've climbed up and down that mountain on one leg if I wanted. I was a soldier, you see, so I had to stay in top physical condition. But war can be cruel. After a few nasty injuries, it was a wonder I made it back here at all.

64.original: It was thinking about my time in service, though, that reminded me that soldiers now will be needing any medicine they can get their hands on.

65.original: We don't have much, but with everyone pitching in, we can usually sell enough to get by.

66.original: Just enough for warm clothes and food to fill our bellies. It's a simple life, but I wouldn't trade it for anything.
